about: Every cheese with a production figure first, most tonnes first (mostly 2024 US NASS, and national, consortium and interprofession figures for single cheeses, some from 2014 to 2023), then those known only by fame (TasteAtlas ratings, consumption surveys), loosely in the order those put them. The figures are not like for like: some are US-only, some one country or one protected name, so cheeses made worldwide (mozzarella, cheddar, feta, cream cheese) are understated, and no world total by variety exists.

sources.name: USDA NASS, Dairy Products 2024 Summary (April 2025)
sources.measures: US cheese production by variety in 2024, 1,000 lb (converted here to tonnes at 0.4536 t per 1,000 lb): mozzarella 4,788,499; cheddar 3,785,308; cream and Neufchatel 1,156,546; Parmesan 447,731; Hispanic 434,897; provolone 387,243; Swiss 360,264; ricotta 242,208; Muenster 210,313; feta 154,954; blue and Gorgonzola 87,052; Gouda 79,479; cottage cheese curd, creamed and lowfat 1,258,578 together. Colby and Monterey Jack are only reported inside 'other American' (1,791,235).

sources.name: Grana Padano consortium, results 2024 (via granapadano.it and efanews.eu)
sources.measures: Grana Padano PDO 2024: 5,635,153 wheels, 219,259 tonnes; exports about 2.69 million wheels.

sources.name: Parmigiano Reggiano consortium 2024 results (Perishable News, Deli Market News)
sources.measures: Parmigiano Reggiano 2024: 4.079 million wheels; Deli Market News gives over 163,000 tons (not confirmed on a consortium page).

sources.name: Assolatte via QDS (2024 Italian dairy)
sources.measures: Italian production 2024: Gorgonzola about 63,000 t, Pecorino Romano about 39,000 t, Provolone Valpadana about 7,000 t.

sources.name: Mozzarella di Bufala Campana consortium (via Il Sole 24 Ore, AGI)
sources.measures: Certified PDO output 2024: 55,718 tonnes.

sources.name: INAO / CNAOL, Chiffres cles produits laitiers AOP 2024
sources.measures: French AOP cheese tonnes marketed in 2024: Comte 65,251; Reblochon 15,775; Roquefort 13,990; Saint-Nectaire 13,803; Cantal 10,840; Morbier 10,796; Brie de Meaux 6,489; Munster 5,590; Fourme d'Ambert 5,464; Camembert de Normandie 5,340; Beaufort 5,211.

sources.name: Statista, production volume of Gouda and Edam in the Netherlands (citing ZuivelNL)
sources.measures: Dutch Gouda about 600 million kg in 2020; Edam just under 115 million kg in 2020 (figures read from Statista summary text; the page values are paywalled).

sources.name: Swiss cheese production 2024 (diegruene.ch)
sources.measures: Le Gruyere AOP 30,311 t and Emmentaler AOP 12,395 t in 2024 (secondary source).

sources.name: DairyReporter, Everything you wanted to know about Feta
sources.measures: Greek feta production, more than 123,000 tonnes a year (other estimates 100,000 to 127,000).

sources.name: CySTAT via Cyprus Mail / Fast Forward (Cyprus industrial sales 2023)
sources.measures: Halloumi sales of 41.9 thousand tons in 2023; exports 39,078 t in 2023.

sources.name: Manchego DOP (Castilla-La Mancha / interempresas.net)
sources.measures: Manchego DOP about 17 million kg of cheese a year.

sources.name: Oaxaca cheese (Wikipedia, citing CANILEC / Statista)
sources.measures: Mexican Oaxaca cheese just under 30,000 t in 2020 (Statista: 28.8 thousand t).

sources.name: TasteAtlas 100 Best Rated Cheeses (as reported by The Local and Connexion France, Feb 2023)
sources.measures: Fame by user rating: Parmigiano Reggiano 1, Gorgonzola piccante 2, burrata 3, Oaxaca 5, Serra da Estrela 8, Reblochon 13, Comte 14, Manchego curado 22, Gruyere 29, Camembert 91. Ratings, not volume. The site itself returned 403.

sources.name: Tetra Pak consumer behaviour research, 2021
sources.measures: Nine-country survey: mozzarella and cheddar are the most popular cheeses, half of consumption between them.

sources.name: Eurostat, Production of cheese (tag00040) and 2019 news item
sources.measures: EU cheese by country and by moisture class only (EU about 10.4 million t in 2022), no variety lines.

sources.name: Consorzio Tutela Taleggio, 2024 (via Beverfood)
sources.measures: Taleggio PDO production 2024: 8,693,815 kg.

sources.name: CSQA press release on Montasio PDO (Ismea-Qualivita report 2025)
sources.measures: Montasio PDO about 6,000 t certified (an older CSQA release says 6,500 t).

sources.name: Appenzeller Switzerland, general assembly 2024 press release
sources.measures: Appenzeller 8,194 t in business year 2023, down 3.2% (also: Swiss cheese total 204,326 t in 2024).

sources.name: CIHEAM, Greek PDO cheeses table (year and units not stated in the snippet)
sources.measures: Greek PDO cheese output, apparently tonnes: Kasseri 3,759; Kefalotiri 3,580; Kefalograviera 2,189.

sources.name: Euronews, Naxos graviera production falters (2026)
sources.measures: Graviera Naxou about 1,200 to 1,250 t a year.

sources.name: Mercasa, Las denominaciones de origen marcan tendencia (figures for 2014)
sources.measures: Spanish PDO cheese, 2014: Tetilla about 1.4 million kg; Idiazabal about 1 million kg; Cabrales, Roncal under 0.5 million kg.

sources.name: Agencia Minas / Emater-MG (Minas Gerais family agroindustry 2025)
sources.measures: Queijo Minas Artesanal about 18,400 t in 2025 (all artisanal Minas cheeses together, Canastra among them).

sources.name: 9colonne, TasteAtlas best cheeses report (Parmigiano Reggiano, buffalo mozzarella, stracchino)
sources.measures: Fame: stracchino named among the best-rated cheeses in the TasteAtlas list.
